summary: Match 3 Bubble Pop game with spinning bubbles!
description:
Play this very addictive Classic Bubble Spinner pop game with the friendly fox for FREE. It is a relaxing and funny game.
Match 3 colored bubbles and clear all the awesome levels and challenges.

Download it and have a great time training your brain by matching bubbles and beating tons of levels online or offline.  

Your task is to aim & shoot three matching bubbles, make them drop and pop until all are burst.
It has a huge twist over the traditional bubble games - the bubbles are spinning.

In this puzzle good aiming and also using the walls to reflect is key!
Prove your strategy skills and compete with your friends and family.

LETS GO!
This fantastic bubble spinner puzzle game could be played by everyone but it there is challenge to solve with any new level.  
- Drag and use the electric bolt to aim!
- You need to match 3 or more bubbles to pop them. 
- Every hit makes the board spin.
- You need to find your own strategy and plan your shoots wisely. 
- Pop all the bubbles and destroy the cage in the middle of the board as last item to get 3 stars.
- You get one of the supporting boosters for reaching 3 stars in a level. ( One time per level )
- Electric Bolt is the booster to better aim reflecting the walls
- The Fan gives you an additional try, if you missed the level!

This great indie physics game is helping to train your strategy skills and your brain!
